name: Encharge
description_en:
Encharge organizes marketing automation around people moving through visual Flows. Triggers start work, filters determine which path continues, and actions send messages or change data. Its company-profile page positions shared company information as another input for B2B onboarding and account-based communication.

A useful evaluation starts with a narrow lifecycle task, such as reminding a trial user to complete one action and ending the sequence after activation. The important work is deciding what repeats, which paths an end action cancels, and what happens when a running flow is extended. These distinctions make Encharge more than a timed newsletter sequence, but they also require the team to maintain clear event and identity definitions. This is a public-documentation assessment, without account execution.
description_zh:
Encharge 围绕人员在可视化 Flow 中的流转组织营销自动化。触发器启动任务，筛选器决定哪些路径继续，动作负责发送消息或修改数据。公司档案页还将共享公司信息定位为 B2B 引导与账户型沟通的输入。

可从一个较窄的生命周期任务开始评估，例如提醒试用用户完成某个动作，并在激活后结束序列。重点是决定哪些行为可以重复、结束动作会取消哪些路径，以及运行中的流程扩展后会发生什么。这些区别使 Encharge 超出定时简报序列，同时也要求团队维护明确的事件与身份定义。本稿基于公开文档，未操作账户。

core_features.explanation_en: A once-only flow setting can block re-entry through any trigger in that flow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 流程的一次性设置可阻止从该流程任何触发器再次进入。

core_features.explanation_en: End Flow cancels the selected flow for a person, including disconnected paths.
core_features.explanation_zh: End Flow 会结束该人员在选定流程中的执行，包括不相连路径。

core_features.explanation_en: Appending steps asks whether existing people should continue into them.
core_features.explanation_zh: 追加步骤时可选择是否让既有人员继续进入。

core_features.explanation_en: The product page describes company fields and relationships with multiple people.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品页说明公司字段及其与多位人员之间的关系。

en: Editorial fit: a SaaS lifecycle team with defined product events and clear trial-to-paid transitions.
Editorial fit: a B2B operator evaluating shared company data and explicit cross-flow message coordination.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：产品事件明确、试用转付费边界清晰的 SaaS 生命周期团队。
编辑判断的适用场景：评估共享公司数据，并需要明确协调跨流程消息的 B2B 运营团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Map email, userId and company relationships to the source system.
steps.zh: 将邮件、userId 及公司关系映射到源系统。

steps.en: Verify a business sending address before designing a real delivery evaluation.
steps.zh: 设计真实投递评估前，先验证企业发件地址。

steps.en: Specify repeat-entry and all target flows affected by conversion.
steps.zh: 明确重复入场，以及转化后受影响的全部目标流程。

steps.en: Test extension choices and compare observed subscription/event usage with the account allowance.
steps.zh: 测试追加步骤的选择，并比较实际订阅者／事件用量与账户额度。

items.en: Several general and detailed official articles disagree; affected claims are explicitly scoped in this draft.
items.zh: 多篇概览与专题官方文章说法不同，本稿已对相关主张明确限定范围。

items.en: Actual pause-clock, delivery-retry and event-idempotency behavior was not tested.
items.zh: 未测试实际暂停计时、投递重试及事件幂等性。

items.en: Company features are vendor-documented capabilities, not independently verified integration outcomes.
items.zh: 公司功能属于厂商文档能力，未独立验证集成效果。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The original pricing guide describes subscriber-based tiers and automatic upgrade after exceeding the subscriber allowance. It separately documents monthly event caps: Growth 50 times the plan subscriber maximum, Premium 100 times; event ingestion stops at the cap without automatic tier upgrade. Its broad unlimited-email wording does not establish a verified zero-overage entitlement. Current plan-card amounts and email allowances were not successfully read: pricing-body requests timed out and ordinary HTTPS returned 403; search excerpts were not substituted. Trial: 14 days, up to 1,000 subscribers, no card per signup guide. No permanent free plan or normalized quote is asserted.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 计费指南原页说明按订阅者档位收费，超出订阅者额度后自动升档；另列月事件上限：Growth 为套餐订阅者上限的 50 倍，Premium 为 100 倍，达到事件上限后停止接入，不自动升档。其笼统的无限邮件表述不足以确认无超额费权益。当前套餐卡金额及邮件额度未能成功实读：定价正文请求超时，正常 HTTPS 返回 403，未以搜索片段代替。注册指南说明试用为 14 天、最多 1,000 订阅者、无需信用卡。不宣称永久免费套餐，也不生成标准化报价。

sources.title: How Do People Enter a Flow? | Encharge Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read default repeat entry and flow-level versus trigger-level once-only control. End Flow and filter rejection do not alone block later entry.

sources.title: Action - End Flow | Encharge Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read End Flow ending all disconnected paths within a selected flow, with current flow default and optional other flows; not merely the connected branch.

sources.title: Activate, Duplicate, Edit, Archive, or Share a Flow | Encharge Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read autosave, 20-second activation delay, pause-before-edit advice and older statement that exited people cannot continue to new steps. Detailed extension article contradicts that last blanket statement.

sources.title: Add New Steps to a Flow After It Has Been Activated | Encharge Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read explicit continuation decision when appending steps. Yes includes people after End Flow/filter steps and ignores prior On-open condition for that continuation; 30-second safeguard. Preserve difference from lifecycle overview.

sources.title: Archive People | Encharge Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read archive preventing mail and flow entry, ejecting current journeys, manual-only restore and not-yet-expired Wait exception. Not equivalent to unsubscribing.

sources.title: What are People in Encharge? | Encharge Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read older identity-based subscriber definition and no-company-record statement. Current pricing guide includes anonymous flow entrants, and actual Company Profiles marketing page contradicts no-company assertion.

sources.title: Encharge Pricing Explained | Encharge Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read current original guide dated March 2026: count identified non-unsubscribed people and anonymous flow entrants; exclude unsubscribed/archived/deleted. Events have separate cap and stop ingestion on excess. Unlimited-email phrase not treated as verified zero-overage entitlement.

sources.title: Step 1: Sign up or Log Into Encharge | Encharge Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read 14-day trial up to 1,000 subscribers, no card, email verification and verified business sending address requirement.

sources.title: Company Profiles – Encharge
sources.research_notes_en: Read Company Profiles body covering company fields, related people, many-to-many, Companies API and CRM sync as vendor capabilities. No result percentages adopted.

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_zh: 先决定哪些事应该发生两次
sections.en: People can re-enter by default, even after a filter rejects them or End Flow ejects them. The flow-level once-only setting covers all triggers; a trigger-level control has narrower scope. For a repeated product event such as inviting a teammate, decide whether each occurrence deserves a new acknowledgement or whether one lifecycle notice is enough. A filter can stop downstream actions without preventing the entry itself, so entry counts and delivered messages should not be read as interchangeable.
sections.zh: 默认情况下人员可以重入，即使此前被筛选器拒绝或被 End Flow 移出。流程级一次性设置覆盖所有触发器，触发器级控制范围更窄。对于邀请队友之类可重复发生的产品事件，应先决定每次发生都需确认，还是一条生命周期通知就够了。筛选器可阻止后续动作，却不一定阻止入场本身，因此不能把入场数量与投递消息数量等同。

sections.title_en: End the intended sequence, not an unrelated path
sections.title_zh: 结束目标序列时要留意其他路径
sections.en: Consider a hypothetical trial-reminder flow with one path for onboarding and another for a feature tutorial. A paid-state trigger connected to End Flow can terminate the selected flow, including both paths even when they are not connected on the canvas. Select the target flows deliberately; the current flow is the default. If tutorial messages should survive conversion, test that requirement separately instead of assuming an end action affects only the branch beside it.
sections.zh: 假设试用提醒流程中，一条路径用于引导，另一条用于功能教程。付费状态触发器连接 End Flow 后，可以终止选定流程，包括画布上彼此不相连的两条路径。应有意识地选择目标流程，默认目标为当前流程。如果转化后仍需保留教程消息，应单独测试这一需求，不能认为结束动作只影响它旁边的分支。

sections.title_en: Appending a step can move an old audience
sections.title_zh: 追加步骤可能推动旧受众
sections.en: The dedicated extension article lets the operator decide whether previous people continue. Choosing Yes applies even after End Flow or a filter, and can bypass the previous connection condition such as On open. It documents a 30-second delay to remove the new step before continuation. The lifecycle overview instead says exited people will not continue, so its blanket statement is inconsistent with the specialized article. Review the actual continuation prompt in an evaluation account before any production edit.
sections.zh: 专题扩展文章允许操作者决定此前人员是否继续。选择 Yes 后，即使前一步是 End Flow 或筛选器，也会继续，还可能忽略 On open 等原连接条件。文档说明有 30 秒延迟，可在继续前移除新增步骤。生命周期概览却说已退出人员不会继续，这一笼统说法与专题文章不一致。生产编辑前，应在评估账户核对实际继续提示。

sections.en: Archived people do not count toward the account limit, cannot receive emails or enter flows, and are ejected from current flows. A form submission does not automatically restore them. Manual restoration normally does not recreate previous journeys; the guide gives an exception for someone archived on a Wait step whose wait has not expired. Archiving is therefore a lifecycle decision, not a simple temporary mute or a guaranteed way to resume where someone stopped.
sections.zh: 归档人员不计入账户上限，无法接收邮件或进入流程，并会被移出现有流程。提交表单不会自动恢复。手动恢复通常不重建此前旅程；指南给出的例外是归档时处于 Wait 且等待尚未到期。因此归档属于生命周期决策，不是简单的临时静音，也不能保证恢复后从原处继续。

sections.title_en: Check shared data against current capability pages
sections.title_zh: 依据当前能力页核对共享数据
sections.en: The older People article says a Company record type is unsupported. The actual Company Profiles page now describes company fields, many-to-many people relationships, Companies API and two-way CRM company-data sync. Preserve that documentation mismatch rather than reporting the older absence as current fact. For account-based evaluation, define a company-level subscription state and which member should receive a notice, then verify plan availability and actual relationship behavior. No CRM sync accuracy was measured.
sections.zh: 旧 People 文章说不支持 Company 记录类型，而实际 Company Profiles 页面已说明公司字段、多对多人员关系、Companies API 及公司数据的 CRM 双向同步。应保留这一文档差异，不能把旧文的不支持说成当前事实。评估账户型沟通时，先定义公司层面的订阅状态及应接收通知的成员，再核对套餐权限与实际关系行为。本次未测量 CRM 同步准确性。

sections.title_en: Subscriber growth and event ingestion fail differently
sections.title_zh: 订阅者增长与事件接入超额后果不同
sections.en: The pricing guide counts identified people who have not unsubscribed and also anonymous people who entered a Flow. It excludes unsubscribed, archived and deleted people. This is broader than the older People article’s email-or-userId shorthand. Subscriber overage causes a tier upgrade; crossing the separate event limit stops receiving events rather than upgrading. Estimate high-frequency tracking alongside audience growth, because a flow can become incomplete when new behavior stops arriving. Confirm the account’s actual allowances before launch.
sections.zh: 计费指南计入尚未退订的已识别人员，也计入进入过 Flow 的匿名人员，并排除已退订、已归档及已删除人员。这比旧 People 文章中“邮件地址或 userId”的简写更广。订阅者超额会升档，独立事件上限超额则会停止接收事件，而不会自动升档。应同时估算高频跟踪与受众增长，因为行为数据不再到达时，流程可能变得不完整。上线前以账户实际额度核对。

sections.title_en: Verify the sending identity before a trial flow
sections.title_zh: 试用流程前先验证发件身份
sections.en: The signup guide documents a no-card 14-day trial for up to 1,000 subscribers. A free email address can register an account, but sending requires a verified business address. Flows autosave, and activation has a documented 20-second delay. The lifecycle guide recommends pausing before editing; it does not establish every delay, retry or queued-action behavior during a pause. Use a small internal audience to test the chosen event, data update and end condition, without treating a preview as an end-to-end send test.
sections.zh: 注册指南说明提供无需信用卡、最多 1,000 订阅者的 14 天试用。免费邮箱可注册账户，但发送要求验证企业邮箱。Flow 自动保存，激活有文档说明的 20 秒延迟。生命周期指南建议编辑前暂停，但它未说明暂停期间所有等待、重试或排队动作的行为。应以小型内部受众测试选定事件、数据更新与结束条件，不能把预览当作端到端发送测试。

seo.title_en: Encharge: behavior email flows, re-entry and customer data
seo.title_zh: Encharge：行为邮件流程、重入与客户数据
seo.description_en: Understand Encharge Flow entry, End Flow scope, extensions, archiving, company profiles and separate subscriber/event limits.
seo.description_zh: 了解 Encharge Flow 入场、End Flow 范围、流程扩展、归档、公司档案及独立订阅者／事件上限。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Encharge lifecycle flows and operational constraints
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Current plan amounts, email allowances and overage fees need an accessible primary pricing read or account quote.
research_gaps.zh: 当前套餐金额、邮件额度及超额费需要可访问的定价原页或账户报价。

research_gaps.en: No flow execution, send test, company sync or billing reconciliation was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行流程、测试发送、同步公司数据或核对账单。

research_gaps.en: UI languages, regional service eligibility and self-hosting rights remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 界面语言、地区服务资格与自托管权利仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
